about:
Pan Pacific Plastics Mfg Inc was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Hayward, California. The company is independently owned and operated by a woman and is certified by the National Minority Supplier Development Council (NMSDC). It emphasizes family values among its employees and has built a reputation over four decades in the packaging industry.

The company manufactures and imports a full line of packaging bags made from paper and plastic. At its Hayward facility, Pan Pacific performs plastic extrusion, printing, and converting in an expanded manufacturing plant. It also maintains manufacturing partnerships across Asia to provide additional paper and plastic product capacity. Domestic production offers low minimums — as little as 100 pounds of plastic extrusion — with lead times of approximately four to six weeks; import lead times run ten to twelve weeks.

Pan Pacific serves a broad range of industries including grocery, retail, promotional, industrial, agricultural, food service, airline, travel, and hospitality. Its customer base includes Fortune 500 companies as well as individual homes and businesses worldwide. Product lines cover tamper-evident, retail, food service, industrial, and eco-friendly bags.

The company states its mission is to provide quality service and products at competitive prices while actively creating innovative packaging ideas. Differentiators cited include price protection programs that guarantee pricing and inventory for up to a full calendar year, an in-house graphic art department for artwork proofs and cleanup, and quality control inspections at both factory and warehouse levels. Responsiveness and customer support are described as staples of its business model.
